about: The starter-staple pool (v0.9.12, a proposal awaiting the owner's approval; docs/economy.md): cards nearly every Commander deck wants, each one an account may claim with a pick as a functional copy bound to it. Claimed copies are built with, never owned: they cannot be sold and come out of no print run. The pool is off until the starter_staples policy is on. No card here is on the Reserved List; tests/test_entitlements.py checks that.
